## What landed

**The adjudication itself — all eleven codes, both directions honest.**

- **`C-LINK-8` (`AmbiguousSelector`) and `C-LINK-9`
  (`DialectNarrowingUndeclared`) gained real emitters — `U` → `X`.**
  The compiler is the producer the rows already named; what was missing
  was the typed-diagnostic carriage: the two standalone link-stage
  `CompileError` variants carried only a detail string, so the assembly
  service's stage-6b could not mint the matching `C-LINK-*` row (a
  standalone refusal degraded to a generic `PlanRefusal`-shaped row —
  the typed code was lost at the boundary). Fix: `CompileError` gained
  the `LinkError{diagnostics}` carriage on the two standalone link
  variants; `link` mints `C-LINK-8` at the `resolve_chain` tie and
  `C-LINK-9` at the dialect-narrowing check;
  `family::check_dialect_transform` mints `C-LINK-9` under compiler
  provenance; `hh-compile`'s JSON error path preserves the member;
  `hh-embed`'s `lab.assembly.compile` result surfaces
  `compile_diagnostics`; `stage6b_diags` reports a carried diagnostic
  verbatim and still spells the code on a diagnostics-empty refusal.
  The rows move `U` → `X`, **not** `U` → `F`: the corpus driver lives
  in `hh-assembly` and cannot depend upward on `hh-compiler`, so the
  `F` (fixture-emitted through the corpus's own builders) class is
  structurally unreachable for a link-stage code — the honest ceiling
  is `X` with the emitting tests living in `hh-compiler`.
  Regression: remove the carriage or either mint site and the new
  compiler/lab legs fail.
- **`C-REF-2` (`RefAmbiguous`) and `C-REF-3` (`RefNameCollision`)
  re-classified `X` → `U`.** The prior `X` reasons named error *types*
  that exist (`hh_registry`'s collision refusal; `resolve`'s ambiguity
  arm) — but an existing error type is not emission of the code.
  `C-REF-3` is minted by publish/admission paths, not by any document
  stage; `C-REF-2`'s ambiguity arm exists in `resolve` but no valid
  document reaches it (extension selection is a newest-match rule, so
  the ambiguity branch is armed but unproducible). Both reasons now
  name the owner and the concrete re-open precondition.
- **The seven remaining `U` rows ruled with named owners + re-open
  preconditions:** `C-PROF-3` (experiment-plane `ExperimentRefusal`
  owns the pinned-across-profiles verdict — the document grammar never
  carries a profile pin; re-opens if a document-side pinning member is
  added), `C-LCD-1` (the validate:7 hosting-edge scan is armed but the
  closed `EdgeKind` set has no host edge kind — re-opens if the HIR
  edge vocabulary admits one), `C-LOC-1`/`C-TRUST-1` (instantiate's
  `BindFailure`/`BindReason` are lifecycle bind events, not document
  diagnostics — re-open if bind outcomes gain a diagnostic spelling),
  `C-RES-1` (`verify_resume`'s verdict surfaces as
  `EmbedError::DefinitionChanged`, a boundary refusal — re-opens if a
  document-side resume check is added), `C-SEAL-1` (the compiler's
  stage-5 seal self-check mints it on a re-encode defect — defect-gated
  by construction, and §3.3.8's closed `Stage` set has no `seal`
  spelling; interim convention reports it under `validate:6b`; the
  taxonomy gap is registered as **CF-492**), `C-CLASS-7` (registry
  admission owns dialect-compatibility refusal — the document layer
  never sees an incompatible class/dialect pair; re-opens if a
  document-side compatibility check is added).
- **Map totals unchanged:** 36 `F` / 49 `X` / 9 `U` / 1 `N` over 95
  codes — `C-LINK-8`/`-9` `U`→`X`, `C-REF-2`/`-3` `X`→`U` net out; the
  corpus gate's INDEX↔`Code::all()`↔`kern_code` drift test still holds
  and now pins the sharpened reasons.
